what: A rounded-rhombus (851×810) window shows only its vertex 35vh up from the screen bottom. From when the panel head is 25vh above the screen top until the panel’s bottom edge touches the screen top, it grows with no curve from min(max(width×.35, 400), height×.55) → (width+height)×2.4 and covers the screen (the first 12 of 72 cells total). In the span before that (panel head from the screen bottom → 25vh from the top), the window rises following from 50% down, and the video inside the window is scrubbed by scroll from start to end over progress .04 → .65. The head text blurs over the first 8 cells.

options.grow: Full-grown size = (width + height) × this value, default 2.4
options.peek: How far below the 70% screen line the window starts (share of screen height), default .35
options.lag: Delay before the window starts growing (vh the panel head has passed over the screen), default 25
options.round: Diamond corner roundness (length on an 851 basis), default 70
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel pinned to the screen (required) — sticky 100vh
options.[data-fx-part=media]: Video or photo to show inside the window (required) — scrubs the inner video with scroll
options.[data-fx-part=head]: Heading above the window (optional) — blurs out at 8/72

use: …
note: The remaining choreography such as number rows and text is layered on by whoever uses it, on the same grid (72 cells) as the original — the original puts a text line at cell 18, a divider at 20, numbers at 22, a second group at 34, and the exit at 68.

from.where: index.html .hm-hiw (original home how-it-works [home-hiw-scrub] — a 15s video scrubbed by scroll inside a rounded diamond window)
